notes.title: Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
I've released a hotfix. Here's what changed:

- Fixed some issues with gallery images not displaying.
- Corrected a couple of spelling errors.
- Fixed a continuity issue in one of Goro's epilogue scenes.
- Fixed "Return to previous choice" displaying an incorrect background after Ladon's 'Bad End' scene.
- Edited Leilani's epilogue Bad End to explain his powers better.
- Fixed text-to-art discrepancy in one of Goro's epilogue scenes.

notes.title: Final Release
notes.content:
[h1]Tayla's Big Adventure - Final Release![/h1]

After a year-long development process, the game is now [b]complete! [/b]It's been a long journey, and I couldn't have done it without your support, so... [b]THANK YOU![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760019/15dac5641727915b2a5731355a452b52e3d3abfb.png[/img]


The full game is now around [b]100,000 words long[/b], similar to the first game, and features [b]over 500 pictures[/b] by your favourite western hentai artists!

So, what's new in 1.0? Direct your eyes below:


[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Added the Epilogue, an extended final chapter containing over 12 new ero scenes.
[*]     Added over 15 new ero scenes, including 3 new Bad Endings!
[*]     Added the remainder of Rayne’s side-story.
[*]     Added the Kickstarter-backed Rat Heist story. To view it, speak to Tony in the epilogue!
[*]     8 new characters with full sprites join the main cast! Say hello to Asterius the minotaur-MILF, Ladon the giant drakon, and Ratilda the rat girl... in addition to 5 Kickstarter-backed rat characters.
[*]     Stomach backgrounds for vore scenes are now animated.
[*]     Added a new, high-octane music track.
[*]     Added new sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Afterword:[/h2]

It's been an honour and a privilege to make these games for all of you, and I hope you enjoy playing them as much as I love making them.

So... get stuck in, and enjoy what I've spent the last year brewing up for you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760019/ef36812f005f8907a914718a0779ba82fd2a50aa.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[i][b]​Tayla's Big Adventure: Version 0.3 is now available![/b][/i]

​Here's a list of new features:

- Chapters 5 and 6 have been added, rounding off the 'main story' of the game.

- 12 new CG scenes have been added, including single-image scenes, ones with alts, and animated scenes.

- 4 new characters join the cast, including the [b]true antagonist[/b] ​and a cute centaur boy in Rayne's side-story.

- Rayne's side-story has been expanded: its first two 'episodes' are interspersed between the main game's chapters.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760019/e1204d32a5eb79d84c27a3603abae2667f84fbd6.png[/img]

notes.title: Tayla's Big Adventure - Version 0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760019/e2cd09cc486d5553cdb037195ba1cfe9ff286b36.png[/img]


It's time for the very first update to [b]Tayla's Big Adventure![/b]

Here's a list of new features:


[b]CGs:[/b]

- Added [b]7 animated ero scenes[/b]. Animations can be toggled on/off in the Preferences menu!

- Coloured the two ero scenes that were only sketches until now.

- Added the first two ero scenes from Rayne's side-story, wherein she meets a centaur in the Realm of Ideal Form.


[b]User Interface:[/b]

- Revamped the [b]UI[/b] (choice buttons, menus, etc).


[b]Sound:[/b]

- Added a stinger noise that plays during Bad Endings.

---

[b]WARNING:[/b] The update might break your save file. If you get an error, choose a different file or start a new game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760019/988edc44f7078b6689b54554ea356ca41755e0f4.png[/img]
